purpose: Governed self-scoped acceptance capability that converts one still-fresh confirmation-required move proposal into canonical Schedule placement truth with hard-admissibility revalidation and exact replay.

routine.return_type: TABLE(proposal_ref uuid, schedule_ref uuid, subject_native_ref uuid, previous_placement_material_state_ref uuid, placement_material_state_ref uuid, created_at timestamp with time zone, replayed boolean)

state_history.material_state_behavior: Acceptance appends one new Schedule placement MaterialState and retains proposal/acceptance evidence.
state_history.current_binding: Revalidates exact proposal placement basis and exact Movement Policy basis before advancing Schedule currentness.
state_history.chronology: Accepted placement history advances monotonically at confirmation time; replay returns the originally accepted placement effect.
state_history.immutability_policy: Proposal and prior placement/policy states are not rewritten; stale proposal basis rejects.

lifecycle.retention: Retain proposal, acceptance receipt and Schedule placement history for replay and reconstructible governance.

obligations: proposal remains pending until explicit accept
acceptance requires unchanged confirmation-required automatic policy basis
hard Temporal Constraints are revalidated at acceptance
one proposal is accepted at most once
